msg: Hi there! I'm Marieke from the Netherlands, travelling on my own through Colombia. I'll be in Cartagena next week and I'd love to go diving. I got my Open Water about six years ago, but my last dive was four years ago in Egypt. Do I need some kind of refresher, or can I just join a normal trip?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Diving in the Rosario Islands is a lovely way to get back underwater. Since your last dive was four years ago, a refresher is normally required before joining a regular fun dive.

The refresher is a one-day activity with pool practice and one reef dive with a PADI instructor. It includes the boat trip from Cartagena, equipment and lunch. There’s no theory to complete beforehand.

You’ll need to present your Open Water certification card, and complete the required medical form. After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying.

You'll also need:
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included (on multi-day plans, the first day's)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena, I'm staying in Getsemaní. I have two free days next week, Tuesday and Wednesday, and then I fly to Medellín on Thursday at 10 in the morning. Would it make sense to do the refresher on Tuesday and then a normal dive trip on Wednesday? And is that flight okay?
reply:
Yes, doing the refresher on Tuesday and a regular dive trip on Wednesday makes sense. Since you’re a certified diver and your last dive was four years ago, a refresher is normally required before returning to regular dives.

Your Thursday 10:00 a.m. flight is okay after Wednesday’s daytime dives: you need to wait at least 18 hours from your last dive, and daytime activities end around 12:00–1:00 p.m. You can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day. The boat returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m., but the waiting period is counted from your last dive, not your return.

The refresher departs at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. The regular two-dive trip also departs from Cartagena. Your Getsemaní stay is about five minutes from the historic center, but transport to the dock isn’t included.

✅ *Refresher added* — it is the mini-course: pool training and one dive with an instructor, on its own day. It costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. Book it here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: That sounds perfect, thank you. Two quick things: I left my plastic card at home and only have the PADI eCard on my phone, is that enough? And can I pay with my Dutch credit card on the website, or do I need to bring cash for anything?
reply:
Yes, your PADI eCard on your phone is enough—it’s accepted for diving worldwide. Please have it available to show on the day.

You'll also need:
• There is no theory to do beforehand: it is done there, on the day, with the instructor.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

As an international guest, you’ll pay 100% by card on the website; your Dutch credit card is fine, and you’ll use your passport as the ID document. You don’t need to bring cash for the booking.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like to continue with the online booking for your refresher and fun dives?
